normalization: Decode numbered lines; normalize BOM/CRLF and trailing empty lines only. All interior content/whitespace preserved.
scope: Client/server text source, tests, configuration and migrations plus root package/README/gitignore. Excludes QA artifacts, binaries, build output, dependencies, environment/credential files and non-migration SQL dumps.

migration.classification: Historical additive workflow migration with seed/stock DML, not a full database backup.
migration.schemaMetadataSource: Existing read-only schema snapshot from this implementation; no new database connection.
